endpoints.description: Update a location belonging to the authenticated WMS account. Requires locations.manage permission. Include name even when changing only type. Omitted optional fields are retained except for type-dependent settings: non-pick-face types clear sequence and capacities; types other than PICK_FACE and BULK_STORAGE clear allowed products; non-TOTE types clear the parent; non-EQUIPMENT types detach child totes. The response confirms the WMS location update, not completion of stock writeback to a connected store.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique location identifier

requestBody.description: Send the current name and the fields to change. This example changes a QUALITY_CONTROL location to BULK_STORAGE. Schedule the request in your own integration if it must run at a release time; this endpoint has no scheduling field.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Required on every update, including a type-only change. Send the existing name to keep it.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Location type. Omit to keep the existing type. Use BULK_STORAGE to change a quality-control location to bulk storage.

fields.name: barcode
fields.description: Location barcode. Omit to keep it; null or an empty string clears it.

fields.name: minCapacity
fields.description: Non-negative minimum capacity for PICK_FACE. Omit to keep it; null clears it. Supplying a non-PICK_FACE type clears it.

fields.name: maxCapacity
fields.description: Non-negative maximum capacity for PICK_FACE; must not be below the minimum when both are supplied. Omit to keep it; null clears it. Supplying a non-PICK_FACE type clears it.

fields.name: allowMixedClientStock
fields.description: Whether stock for different clients may share the location. Omit to keep the existing setting.

fields.name: visible
fields.description: Whether the location is visible. Omit to keep the existing setting. Setting false also removes default-stocktake status.

fields.name: setAsDefaultStocktake
fields.description: Set true to make this the default stocktake location for PICK_FACE, BULK_STORAGE, STAGING_DOCK, or QUALITY_CONTROL when visible. Set false to remove default status.

fields.name: allowedProductIds
fields.description: Replace the allowed-product list for PICK_FACE or BULK_STORAGE. An empty array clears it. Changing to another type clears the list.

fields.name: sequence
fields.description: Non-negative integer pick-face sequence. Omit to keep it; null clears it. Supplying a non-PICK_FACE type clears it.

fields.name: parentLocationId
fields.description: Parent EQUIPMENT location ID for a TOTE. Omit to keep it; null clears it. Supplying a non-TOTE type clears the parent.

fields.name: childToteIds
fields.description: Replace attached totes for EQUIPMENT. An empty array detaches all child totes. Supplying a non-EQUIPMENT type also detaches existing child totes.

fields.name: zoneId
fields.description: Zone ID belonging to the account. A newly assigned zone must be active. Omit to keep it; null or an empty string clears it.

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Bulk-storage priority from 0 to 10. Omit to keep it for BULK_STORAGE. Other types use 0.

responses.description: Updated location record, without a success or location wrapper. Example shows core fields; use GET /api/location/[id] to retrieve relationships.

  "name": "A-01-01",

  "barcode": null,
  "parentLocationId": null,
  "zoneId": null,
  "sequence": null,
  "minCapacity": null,
  "maxCapacity": null,
  "priority": 0,
  "allowMixedClientStock": true,
  "visible": true,

  "accountId": "account-123"
}
